 Mr.A.A.Dhawas, Advocate for the applicants.
 Coram : Manish Pitale, J.
Date : 01.07.2019.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants.
2. Issue notice, returnable in four weeks.
3. Learned APP Mr. H.R.Dhumale waives notice on behalf of the non-applicant.

4. The applicants herein are apprehending their arrest in respect of FIR dated 16/05/2019,
registered against them for the offences punishable under sections 272, 273, 328 of IPC and section 59 of the Food Safety Standard Act, 2006.

5. The allegation against the applicants is that gutka, which is a banned substance in the State of Maharashtra was being transported in a vehicle belonging to the applicant No.1 and that it was being transported in the vehicle by the applicants.
The FIR shows that the said material worth Rs.60,000/- was recovered from the said vehicle KHUNTE aba417.19.odt and that the gutka as well as the said vehicle were seized.

It is pointed out by the learned counsel for the applicants that they do not have any criminal antecedents and that they are ready to cooperate with the investigation.

It is pointed out that even during the pendency of their application for anticipatory bail before the Sessions Court, they had been granted interim protection and that they had cooperated with the Investigating Agency.
7. In view of the above, a case for grant of ad interim protection is made out.

8. Hence, in the event the applicants are arrested in Crime No.134 of 2019, registered at Police Station Khapa, District Nagpur, they shall be released on bail on furnishing PR bond of Rs.25,000/-
each and surety in the like amount.
The applicants shall attend the Police Station Khapa, District Nagpur once in a week i.e. on every Sunday between 10.00 am and 5.00 pm, during the pendency of this application.
The applicants shall cooperate with the investigation and make themselves available to the Investigating Officer as and when required.
The applicants shall not tamper with evidence or influence the witnesses.
